title: M-Pocket
summary: A Mastodon client for Cardputer Zero.
description:
M-Pocket is an open-source Mastodon client for the Cardputer Zero. Sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone, then browse your home and local timelines from your pocket.

Search for posts, write and review replies, boost posts, and reveal content warnings when you’re ready. M-Pocket can remember your login and offers light and dark purple themes with adjustable text size.
